boundary: Privacy alone would be right if the handler printed the line safely (e.g. printf("%s", line)) so that the only effect were echoing the login identifier; the untrusted-format-string call adds a direct code-integrity vulnerability.
factor: installed code carrying forward an exploitable flaw (user input used as a format string in an auth path)
note: Assessor quoted printf(line) but read it only as echoing the login ID, never stating that attacker-controlled input becomes the format string; accounting for that vulnerability adds Security / System Integrity to Privacy, matching gold.
